notes: Corrected רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה → *the top of Pisgah*: the accepted alignment folded the *the* into the construct noun's unit and left the article on הַפִּסְגָּה unrepresented. The rectum is rendered anarthrously and one *the* is written, so rule 29 gives it to the present article; the construct keeps *top* together with the *unto* rule 33 licenses, discontinuous around the *the*.

*Get thee up*: the *thee* is kept inside the imperative's unit as part of the fixed English idiom and is not a supplied object of an intransitive verb; the competing reading marks it `added` under rule 44.
